name: OpenWrt Firewall Monitor
description: Read-only OpenWrt telemetry via companion collector
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Group justify="space-between"><Text fw={700}>OpenWrt Firewall Events</Text><RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs" /></Group>{!data.snapshot ? <Text>Waiting for data...</Text> : <Stack gap="xs"><Text size="xl" fw={700}>{data.snapshot.events24h ?? 0} logged events / 24h</Text><Badge color={data.snapshot.syslogEnabled ? "green" : "orange"}>{data.snapshot.syslogEnabled ? "Syslog listener enabled" : "Syslog listener disabled"}</Badge><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Only matching logs are counted; zero does not imply zero blocked packets.</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>Top sources</Text>{data.snapshot.topSources?.map((s)=><Text key={s.src} size="xs">{s.src}: {s.count}</Text>)}<Text size="sm" fw={600}>Top blocked ports</Text>{data.snapshot.topPorts?.map((s)=><Text key={s.port} size="xs">{s.port}: {s.count}</Text>)}<Text size="sm" fw={600}>Recent events</Text>{data.snapshot.events?.map((e) => <Paper key={e.timestamp + e.src + e.port} withBorder p="xs"><Group gap="xs"><Badge color="orange">{e.action}</Badge><Text size="xs">{e.src || "?"} → {e.dst || "?"} · {e.proto} {e.port}</Text></Group></Paper>)}</Stack>}</Stack>
